messages:
mira: quick sync — we need a short canonical recommendation for how our SDKs and runtime should acquire KMS credentials across Private/Dedicated. teams currently using env vars, Vault agent, SSM, console-inserted keys; want balance of security + ops.

sam: TL;DR: prefer platform identity (instance profile / Workload Identity / Managed Identity) + short-lived creds. avoid baking long-lived keys in env vars or images.

jordan: AWS -> IAM role / IRSA; GCP -> Workload Identity; Azure -> Managed Identity. fallback to static creds only when unavoidable, and restrict scope.

lee: app calls to KMS should use envelope encryption to limit permissions and cost. minimal pattern: 
```
1) KMS.GenerateDataKey(AES_256) -> {PlaintextDEK, CiphertextDEK}
2) encrypt payload locally with PlaintextDEK (AEAD)
3) zeroize PlaintextDEK asap
4) persist CiphertextDEK with ciphertext
5) on read: KMS.Decrypt(CiphertextDEK) -> PlaintextDEK -> decrypt
```
Cache decrypted DEKs in ephemeral process memory with TTL to reduce KMS calls; never persist.

mira: rotation: some customers require CMK rotation every 90d. recommended approach?

lee: rotation options: enable provider auto-rotation or schedule manual rotation. Rewrap DEKs lazily on first access (Decrypt-with-old -> Encrypt-with-new) or run a controlled background rewrap job. Keep old CMKs usable for decrypt until rewraps complete. Track rewrap state in metadata and avoid immediate deletion.

sam: ops notes: lazy rewrap avoids huge spike; if running bulk jobs, shard work and honour KMS TPS limits. expose max_rewrap_batch_size and concurrency knobs.

jordan: RBAC: least privilege. AWS: kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt scoped to required CMK ARNs. GCP: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on key ring. Azure: Key Vault wrapKey/unwrapKey. Separate admin role for rotate/rewrap/schedule deletion.

mira: quick pros/cons: env, Vault, SSM, Secrets Manager, console?

sam: env vars: easy but leak risk (CI, logs). Vault: best for dynamic leases and injected short-lived creds. SSM Parameter Store: okay for static values; Secrets Manager preferable when you need rotation. Console/manual: admin use only.

lee: recommend SDK credential resolution order: metadata service -> Vault agent socket -> env vars -> shared credentials file. Document how to opt into instance role/Workload Identity.

jordan: defaults: dek_cache_ttl_sec=300 (5m). allow customers to shorten or disable. Cache only in process memory.

sam: SDK config knobs to expose: credentials_provider: "metadata|vault|env|file"; kms_key_id: resource id/alias; dek_cache_ttl_sec: "300"; max_rewrap_batch_size: "100"; audit_id_header: header name; degraded_mode_on_kms_fail: "true|false".

lee: degraded/read-only fallback: reject writes requiring new DEKs if KMS unreachable; allow reads only if DEKs cached; emit alerts and clear audit trail. No silent insecure fallback.

mira: audit logging needs?

sam: enable CloudTrail/Audit Logs for GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, Encrypt. route to central SIEM and immutable storage. correlate KMS events with app request ids (use audit_id_header) and principal identity; long retention for forensics.

jordan: require MFA/approval workflow for admin actions like ScheduleKeyDeletion or manual rotate on production CMKs. High-fidelity alerts for these ops.

lee: SDK safety checks: never log plaintext DEKs or KMS responses; scrub errors that may contain key material; zeroize keys with secure memory wipe; provide dry-run rewrap mode for ops.

vault-bot: vault: secret/rdw/prod/kms-role lease issued to app: billing-svc ttl=600s

mira: include Vault agent + SDK fallback pseudocode in docs, and examples for AWS/GCP/Azure. I'll draft RFC and tag security for review.

sam: sample credential resolution pseudocode:
```
creds = try(metadata_service) || try(vault_agent_socket) || try(env_vars) || try(shared_file)
if !creds:
  raise AuthError("no valid credential provider")
```

jordan: also add exponential backoff with jitter for KMS errors and metrics: kms_call_latency, kms_call_errors, dek_cache_hit_rate, rewrap_progress.

security-bot: reminder: SEC-OPS-5 security review required for infra changes that touch KMS permissions. open PR with policy diff.

mira: noted, thanks all :thumbsup:
